تفتعلوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَعِلُوا (taftaʕilū) /taf.ta.ʕi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# تُفْتَعَلُوا (tuftaʕalū) /tuf.ta.ʕa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
